# Write Attribution Clarity

When applying multiple edits, keep causality traceable for rollback and debugging.

## Group related writes

Cluster edits that implement one decision so diffs tell a coherent story.

## Risk ordering

Apply lower-risk changes before irreversible or widely visible ones when feasible.

## Verify after clusters

Run checks after coherent chunks, not only at the very end when errors are expensive to untangle.
